This '''chocolate mousse''' recipe is low in [[cookbook:carbohydrates|carbohydrates]], and is therefore acceptable for an [[Cookbook:Atkins Diet Cooking|Atkins-style diet]].

==Ingredients==
*1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (240 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) or 1 part [[cookbook:Half and Half|half and half]]
*1 cup (240 ml) or 1 part [[cookbook:Cream|heavy cream]]
*1 cup (240 ml) or 1 part [[cookbook:water|water]]
*4 scoops or 1 part Atkins Chocolate Shake Mix
*2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] or 1/24 part [[cookbook:stevia|stevia]] extract or other [[cookbook:Sweeteners|sugar replacement]]

==Procedure==
#Lightly [[cookbook:whipping|whip]] half and half and cream in a [[cookbook:blender|blender]].
#Add other ingredients into blender.
#Blend everything together until smooth.
#Enjoy.
